elaine: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem (model-serving OOM spikes). I sketched owners/timelines — please confirm or reassign. Trying to close action items this sprint.

elaine: Summary of open actions:
• RDW-1245 investigate KV-cache eviction pattern — owner: ryan — due: 2025-06-03
• RDW-1246 add automated mem-pressure alerts + dashboard — owner: nina — due: 2025-06-10
• RDW-1247 run day-long soak on dedicated pool + perf baseline — owner: jackie — due: 2025-06-17
• RDW-1248 implement graceful fallback to smaller model variant — owner: sam — due: 2025-06-24

elaine: RACI (draft):
```
R: ryan, nina, jackie, sam
A: elaine
C: infra-team, eng-sre
I: customer-success
```

ryan: I can take RDW-1245. First step: reproduce OOM locally with the traffic snapshot. ETA 2 days.

nina: Confirmed on RDW-1246. I'll own alerting + a Grafana dashboard. Can we scope retention to 90d? Need signoff from Eng-SRE.

jackie: On RDW-1247 — I'll need a dedicated slot on the staging cluster. @elaine can you open a reservation with infra? Also will parallelize across models to check quantization regressions.

sam: I can prototype RDW-1248 but need to coordinate with model-ops for variant packaging. Asking for +1 week if model-ops has other priorities.

elaine: Thanks. Action: @elaine -> open infra slot and ping model-ops. I'll also add owners to the postmortem doc and assign watchers.

pm-bot: RDW-1245 assigned to ryan; RDW-1246 assigned to nina; RDW-1247 assigned to jackie; RDW-1248 assigned to sam. Links: https://jira.internal/REDW-1245 https://jira.internal/REDW-1246 https://jira.internal/REDW-1247 https://jira.internal/REDW-1248

sam: small concern — RDW-1248 fallback may affect latency. Proposal: canary fallback for 10% traffic, monitor 95p latency delta. I'll add an eval plan to the ticket.

ryan: For RDW-1245, found an interesting correlation with request size distribution during peak. Pushing logs to RDW-1245.

nina: Eng-SRE approved retention. I'll target daily rollups + 90d raw.

jackie: Infra slot confirmed for 2025-06-05, thanks @elaine.

elaine: OK team — plan: weekly check-ins on Fridays until closure. If anyone needs a timeline shift, flag here by EOD Wed and update the Jira ticket. Closing the loop: I'll follow up with a short checklist in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
